digest.component_or_area: test suite: subprocess and network reliability oracles
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted currently uses production-scale 10-second low-speed window and 15-second loopback server, consuming 15+ seconds per test execution
test_read_retried_then_terminal uses production one-second call timeout plus real backoff sleeps across three processes, consuming ~9 seconds despite testing only retry schedule and process cleanup
snapshot stall test must inject shorter window while maintaining real loopback socket, above-floor byte pacing for multiple window cycles, and non-stall assertion
ACLI subprocess test must inject sub-second call/grace/drain values, record logical [2,4] backoff schedule without sleeping, and verify all spawned PIDs are absent after terminal failure
